remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes, 1999 showed this image in landscape orientation. Based on photographs by O'Keeffe of the roofless room (2006.6.1429 and 2006.6.1428), it was determined that this sketch was better shown in portrait orientation. (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum, 2026)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: An abstract graphite drawing of a section of the roofless room at Georgia's O'Keeffe's house in Abiquiu revealing the overhead latillas and pine vigas forming a ceiling open to the sky.
title: Untitled (Abstraction)
